item.title: AI linked to 84% of ransomware attacks, new report finds
item.description: Amid escalating threats to businesses, former White House cyber chief warns autonomous attacks are already here.

item.title: Trump says Greenland oil, gas and mineral exploration "getting ready to begin"
item.description: The announcement comes four weeks after the U.S. signed a deal with Greenland and Denmark to bolster American military presence on the island.

item.title: Trump pardons 2 auto workers on stage during rally in Alaska
item.description: President Trump granted onstage pardons to two Alaska auto shop owners who pleaded guilty to violating the Clean Air Act during a rally Tuesday — an unusually public use of the president's clemency power.

item.title: Trump issues pardons to 2 auto shop owners at Alaska rally
item.description: President Trump issued pardons for two auto shop owners, who had pleaded guilty to violating the Clean Air Act, during a rally in Wasilla, Alaska, on Tuesday.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's White House ban targeting CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly said the White House's revocation of hard passes for CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists likely violated their First and Fifth Amendment rights.

item.title: Doctors discuss Pope Leo's lung cancer diagnosis
item.description: The Vatican announced that Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer on Tuesday, following a surgery he had on his right lung. Doctors and medical experts spoke with CBS News about the potential prognosis.

item.title: Dolly Parton's nephew pushes back on restraining order
item.description: Dolly Parton's nephew disputed a restraining order that was filed against him by her estate, which accused him of threatening to do violence and destroy her legacy and business empire.

item.title: New details in text messages between Jane Doe and frat members
item.description: One of the accused fraternity members, who was later expelled, wrote to her: "I genuinely hope ur not catching as much heat from this as we r."

item.title: Ossoff says "zero interest in running for president" in Georgia debate
item.description: Sen. Jon Ossoff and Republican challenger Mike Collins traded attacks over the 2020 election and alleged connections to white nationalists. Ossoff also pushed back on speculation that he could run for president in 2028.

item.title: Saudis launch new strikes on Iran-backed Houthis
item.description: As President Trump mulls joining Saudi Arabia in attacking the Houthis, the Iran-backed group threatened a "painful" response.

item.title: Local fire departments blame private equity for rising equipment costs
item.description: Some departments are engaged in a class action lawsuit against apparatus manufacturers.

item.title: AI researcher unpacks Anthropic's self-replication warning
item.description: Anthropic is warning that small artificial intelligence models could soon spread themselves from one internet-connected device to another, including smart TVs and cameras. Jonas Guan, an AI researcher at the University of Toronto, joins to discuss.

item.title: Trump says Houthis are "behaving very badly." What are his options?
item.description: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted Houthi missiles and drones across the kingdom on Tuesday after the rebel group struck an airport over the weekend. CBS News Middle East contributor Courtney Kealy joins with analysis.

item.title: Texts reveal communications between Jane Doe and male Cornell student after alleged gang rape
item.description: Text messages obtained by CBS News reveal communications between Cornell's Jane Doe and one of the men she later accused of assault in the alleged 2024 gang rape. CBS News crime reporter Anna Schecter breaks down the details.

item.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle ousted as ambassador over corruption allegations
item.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle said she is stepping aside as U.S. ambassador to Greece, days after reports that she offered access to officials in exchange for help paying off her debt.

item.title: Pope Leo recovering from surgery at hospital amid lung cancer diagnosis
item.description: Pope Leo has been diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons removed the lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican announced Tuesday. CBS News foreign correspondent Chris Livesay reports. Then, thoracic surgeon Dr. Kalvin Lung joins to discuss the diagnosis.

item.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after undergoing surgery
item.description: Tests confirmed a diagnosis of lung cancer for Pope Leo XIV, the Vatican said in a medical update after he underwent surgery.

item.title: Six Flags closes 9 rides across 6 parks after deadly incident
item.description: Six Flags has temporarily closed rides similar to Goliath, the roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia that a man fell from.

item.title: Trump officials now leaning against execution livestream, sources say
item.description: Last week, the Pentagon had said the execution of the ex-Army major convicted of killing 13 in 2009 would be livestreamed.

item.title: OpenAI employee accused of planting recording device in office
item.description: A Saudi national who worked at OpenAI as an engineer is suspected of planting a recording device in one of the company's conference rooms.

item.title: New York City changes name of street containing Spider-Man's Queens home
item.description: For 37 years, a Queens house has been identified as the childhood home of Spider Man, aka, Peter Parker. The images and exact address were revealed in the pages of "The Amazing Spider Man" back in 1989. Now, the city is honoring that legacy with a street name change. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Anthropic warns certain AI models could soon spread and replicate themselves
item.description: Ina Fried, chief technology correspondent at Axios, joins "The Daily Report" to break down the latest news in AI.

item.title: Over $500 million spent on ads during Texas Senate campaign, AdImpact data shows
item.description: Hundreds of millions have been spent on the Senate race in Texas as Ken Paxton and James Talarico battle it out with only weeks left before the midterms. CBS News' Kaia Hubbard reports.

item.title: Trump travels to Alaska for rally amid tight Senate race between Sullivan and Peltola
item.description: President Trump is traveling 3,400 miles to Alaska on Tuesday to hold a rally amid a tight Senate race there between incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan and Democratic challenger Mary Peltola. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto and Weijia Jiang have more.

item.title: Pope Leo's brother also battling cancer, wife tells CBS News
item.description: Louis Prevost​, Pope Leo XIV's older brother who lives in Florida, has multiple myeloma, his wife told CBS News on Tuesday.

item.title: 10/13: CBS Evening News
item.description: Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer, the Vatican said; Six Flags shut down 10 rides across the U.S. after a fatal fall.

item.title: 10/13: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Vatican reveals Pope Leo XIV's lung cancer diagnosis after surgery; Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece amid White House pressure.

item.title: Duane "Keffe D" Davis sentenced to 40 years to life for Tupac's murder
item.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis​ was sentenced to 40 years to life in prison Tuesday in Las Vegas for the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur.

item.title: Spectacular launch sends cargo ship on voyage to space station
item.description: Along with crew supplies and equipment, the Cargo Dragon is delivering two rollout solar arrays to complete a major power system upgrade.

item.title: Anthropic warns "AI worms" could soon infect smart home devices
item.description: Small AI models could clone themselves and infect internet-connected devices such as smart TVs and appliances, the researchers warned.
